correctness.rationale: Exact adjunction formula on finite downsets proves the Horn materializer condition. The closure operator preserves the antecedent intersection, making it idempotent and identifying all fixed points. Principal/empty antecedent cones imply ambient union closure; a pair of maximal incomparable antecedent-cone points constructs two materializers with a nonmaterializer union. Quantifying antecedents gives exactly forest prelinearity. A nine-element algebra furnishes a seven-element nondistributive example. Exhaustive natural-label poset checks through six points (5231 total posets) and a separate frozenset verifier independently reproduce key identities; no finite check is substituted for the universal proof.

originality.rationale: The 2021 materializer paper supplies the definition and proves ambient meet closure but identifies further structure as a question, without proving the criterion for ambient join closure, its all-antecedent Gödel characterization, or the nondistributive internal example. The 2021 forest-duality paper establishes only the classical equivalence between finite Gödel algebras and finite forests. Exact-name, fixed-point, prelinearity, and poset-duality searches and comparisons of accessible published records found no result implying this combination. This is a best-knowledge comparison, not a uniqueness or independent-priority certificate.

value.rationale: Resolves the specific structural direction raised with the materializer definition: determines precisely when materializers retain ambient lattice joins, and describes their canonical internal lattice when they do not. Ties a nontrivial local antecedent condition to Gödel prelinearity globally and reveals that an internal materializer lattice may be nondistributive even when its ambient Heyting lattice is distributive. The all-size characterization, explicit closure mechanism, and qualitative boundary are mathematically motivated beyond routine examples.
